purpose: Define how historical ticket costs and prize payouts must be represented before financial backtests are considered valid.
rules: Every backtested draw must resolve to exactly one verified rule/prize era.
Ticket cost must be the cost valid on the historical draw date.
Prize evaluation must use the official category and payout for that exact draw whenever payout is variable.
Fixed-prize eras may use verified category tables scoped by validity dates.
Any draw lacking verified cost or prize data is excluded from financial ROI calculations and reported as a gap.
Jackpot amount alone is never used as expected return.
Baseline comparisons must use the same number of tickets, same ticket cost and same draw set as the model.
